subject: Improved speed of CPPTRAJ post-clustering steps for large sets

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi all,
Just FYI I’ve just fixed a performance issue in some of the post-clustering
steps in cpptraj (summary, best representative frames calc, silhouette etc)
that in particular would impact clustering runs on high #s of frames (e.g.
100,000 frames with sieving). The fixes are in version 6.2.0 (GitHub). See
https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj/pull/932
for more details.
-Dan

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Just a quick follow-up: I just found and fixed an issue with
clustering when using a previously generated pairwise distance matrix.
Details here: https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj/pull/934
If you're clustering with cpptraj it's probably worth it to update.
-Dan
